description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Disruptive Pitmage, adding {U}.
When Disruptive Pitmage dies, Yedora triggers, returning Disruptive Pitmage from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Disruptive Pitmage by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Disruptive Pitmage's morph ability by paying {U}, turning it face up.
Repeat.
